hello its me back with another farm map! this one was inspired by wanting a map that looked like a combination of the foraging and mining maps. lots of cliffs and a lil river

this replaces the STANDARD farm map

[u][b]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:[/b][/u]

navigate to your Content\Maps folder in your stardew valley file directory
backup the original farm.xnb file by renaming it farm_BACKUP.xnb or something
unzip the downloaded file and place farm.xnb in your Content\Maps folder
and youre done! have fun playing your new farm map!

[/b][/u]Someone requested a version with a little doghouse so I've uploaded it here
TO INSTALL:
- unzip the downloaded file so you have a folder called "contents"
- inside the contents folder there are four files called spring/summer/fall/winter_doghouse, place these four files in your Content folder
- inside the Maps folder there are the same four files as well as the Farm.xnb file, place these five files in your Contents\Maps folder
- you're good to go! have fun playing :>
